Use these examples in a local page in a current browser. APIs involving files, storage, clipboard or location may need HTTPS, a user action or permission. They are shown as code because this site's sandbox limits those features.

blocks.title: Remember a small browser value

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `localStorage` stores text for this origin and browser. Access can fail, and users can clear the saved values.
`JSON.parse` turns JSON text into JavaScript values. Invalid text throws an error and should be handled for real input.

blocks.text: The console shows 1 where storage is allowed. Otherwise the page gives a handled message.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Browser storage can be cleared or blocked. Do not use it as the only copy of important work.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Store a second title and check the length.
